read_escalated: 🟢 Read-only operation: this request only reads {paths}; no file is modified. The agent wants to widen this one "{tool}" call to {mode} ({gloss}), but the operation itself only reads. The grant covers this single request. {reason}
read_plain: 🟢 Read-only operation: this request only reads {paths}; no file is modified. The grant covers this single request. {reason}
write_escalated: ⚠️ FILE WRITES AHEAD — please confirm. The agent wants to widen this one "{tool}" call to {mode} ({gloss}), and it will write to: {paths}. The grant covers this single request and cannot be undone. If unsure, reject: the agent then stops and explains. {reason}
write_plain: ⚠️ FILE WRITES AHEAD — please confirm. This operation will write to: {paths}. The grant covers this single request and cannot be undone. If unsure, reject: the agent then stops and explains. {reason}
destroy_escalated: 🔴 DESTRUCTIVE OPERATION — please confirm. The agent wants to widen this one "{tool}" call to {mode} ({gloss}), and it will delete or overwrite: {paths}. The grant covers this single request and cannot be undone. If unsure, reject: the agent then stops and explains. {reason}
destroy_plain: 🔴 DESTRUCTIVE OPERATION — please confirm. This operation will delete or overwrite: {paths}. The grant covers this single request and cannot be undone. If unsure, reject: the agent then stops and explains. {reason}
command: ⚙️ Approval needed: the agent wants to run one command with {mode} permissions ({gloss}). The command text is shown in the detail below. No obvious delete or overwrite was found, but the command may still have side effects. The grant covers this single request. {reason}
neutral: Approval needed: the agent asks to run one "{tool}" operation. {original}The grant covers this single request only; rejecting is fine — the agent then stops and explains.
paths_none: (no concrete path found; see the detail below)
paths_command_none: (the command names no path; it may act on the current directory)
paths_command: {paths} (extracted from the command; may be incomplete)
paths_reason: {paths} (extracted from the approval note; may be incomplete)
nested: (the command runs another script inside it; that script was inspected as well.)
nested_truncated: (the nesting went deeper than this plugin inspects; please read the innermost layers yourself.)
nested_too_long: (the command is very long; only the beginning was analysed — please read the rest yourself.)
mode.read-only: read-only; no file writes are allowed
mode.workspace-write: writes become possible inside this workspace and temporary areas; everything else stays read-only
mode.danger-full-access: the sandbox is essentially lifted: any file on this machine can be read or written, any system command may run, and network access is allowed
mode.fallback: wider access than the current sandbox mode
